search_text: published ZDI-20-977 ZDI-CAN-10333 Micro Focus Secure Messaging Gateway manage_domains_save_data SaveData Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-08-10 6.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ['Micro Focus'] ['Secure Messaging Gateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Micro Focus Secure Messaging Gateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within manage_domains_save_data.php. When parsing the SaveData parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the www-data user. Micro Focus has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Micro Focus Secure Messaging Gateway manage_domains_save_data SaveData Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Micro Focus Secure Messaging Gateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within manage_domains_save_data.php. When parsing the SaveData parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the www-data user.
